notes.inflation: CPI is the Department of Statistics Malaysia's consumer price index, with the rates DOSM publishes. The interest rate is Bank Negara Malaysia's overnight policy rate (OPR), shown from May 2004, when it was introduced.
notes.labour: From DOSM's monthly labour force survey, starting in January 2011 after a re-basing of the survey at the end of 2010. Unemployment and participation are seasonally adjusted; the employment-to-population ratio is not, because DOSM's adjusted table does not carry it.
notes.trade: Goods trade as DOSM reports it, in ringgit: exports valued free on board, imports including cost, insurance and freight.
notes.public: Debt and the budget balance are the IMF World Economic Outlook's general government figures, actual years only. The general government balance covers all levels of government, so it differs from the federal deficit the Ministry of Finance headlines.
notes.markets: The exchange rate is the Federal Reserve's daily rate. There is no 10-year government bond yield: the only free monthly series does not state its maturity, so it is not shown.
